## Commands

Run from this app directory. Bun is declared by the workspace; use package scripts before raw tools.

| Purpose | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Development | `bun run dev` |
| Type check | `bun run typecheck` |
| Tests | `bun run test` |
| Production build | `bun run build` |
| Package existing build | `bun run package` |
| Focused test | `bun test tests/picker/picker.test.ts` |

For code changes run the relevant tests, type check and production build. No app lint script or CI workflow was found; do not claim an invented canonical CI check. Development and build regenerate token CSS automatically.

## Boundaries to preserve

- React popup/settings communicate with the content script and background worker through Chrome messaging; host-page DOM belongs to the content script.
- Settings and saved form memory live in `chrome.storage.local`. Preserve persisted shapes and migration behavior; do not log keys or saved values.
- Mock filling works offline; AI calls use the selected provider through the background worker. Do not add a backend or auth service based on sibling apps.
- Keep safety, scoped filling, pinned values and undo semantics intact. Use the shadow-root overlay host for injected UI.
- Use shared tokens and UI primitives. Do not hand-edit generated `src/styles/tokens.css`; see the UI system doc.

## File Organization & Separation of Concerns

- Do **not** append new functionality to the bottom of an existing file by default.
- Before adding code, decide whether the behavior is a separate concern that should live in its own file.
- Prefer creating a new colocated file for distinct concerns (components, hooks, utilities, schemas, data-access helpers).
- If a file is already large or handling multiple responsibilities, extract the new logic into focused modules and import them.
- If a change introduces a distinct cluster of state, effects, handlers, or API calls for one feature, treat that as a strong signal to extract it.
- Keep each file focused on one primary responsibility.

## Working rules

- Plan multi-file or architectural work; keep durable plans in `docs/plans/`. The existing [redesign checklist](docs/UI-REDESIGN-PLAN.md) remains the active UI work record.
- Respect existing authorization to implement; do not repeat a design interview or ask for approval already supplied in the chat.
- Preserve pre-existing working changes. Prefer focused patches and review the diff before reporting completion.
- Follow the inherited import-section comments in the workspace `CLAUDE.md`; details are in the code-style doc.
- Use TypeScript strict types and semantic HTML; follow surrounding formatting. Add no formatter or lint rules without a task reason.
- Use the local `.agents/skills/plan-mode` and `code-review` workflows when relevant. No issue tracker or team-specific branch convention is configured here.
